dedupe_keys.name: indonesia air transport traffic statistics directorate general of civil aviation

description: The Directorate General of Civil Aviation of Indonesia publishes air transport traffic statistics on its website. The page gives national totals of aircraft movements, passengers, transit passengers, cargo, baggage and mail for the last five years (for example about 1.2 million aircraft movements and 166 million passengers in 2025), and a lookup of traffic for one airport, one month and one category across the country's airports, from large hubs to small regional airfields. The figures come from the Directorate of Air Transport, and the page states that they are updated automatically every day. Coverage is national (Indonesia). The statistics are free to view online with no registration; no download format or licence is stated. Caveats: the data are shown as web tables, the current year is partial, and definitions of categories are not documented on the page. They support demand and capacity planning of airports, analysis of disruptions such as volcanic ash closures and recovery after shocks in an archipelago that depends on air links. They complement the ACI World airport traffic statistics and are related to the Brazil ANAC air transport statistics.
